How We're Working Right Now: Claude Fable 5.2
Friday, November 13
12 p.m. ET
Live on Zoom

For the past few weeks, our team has been giving Fable 5.2 bigger projects than we'd give any other model. Dan Shipper ( https://0ab9ee3d.click.kit-mail3.com/n4u68o0qplcvhgw757ef6h667md88hlhvol2o/kkhmh6hn7d7649blh7/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AZGFuc2hpcHBlcg== ) will host, and the team will cover:

* One-shotting a pro app: Kieran Klaassen ( https://0ab9ee3d.click.kit-mail3.com/n4u68o0qplcvhgw757ef6h667md88hlhvol2o/58hvh7hgevekl5u6h4/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9Aa2llcmFuXzEzNTU= ), who built Everycut, our video editor with an agent inside it, will walk through his steps for getting a professional app out of a single prompt.
* What Fable 5.2 changes: Mike Taylor ( https://0ab9ee3d.click.kit-mail3.com/n4u68o0qplcvhgw757ef6h667md88hlhvol2o/25h2hoh35v54n2b3h4/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AbWlrZV8yMTE0 ) will show a timeline of everything he's built with the model, then dig into a few of the projects to explain how you have to work differently with it.
* Cost: Fable 5.2 is slow and uses a lot of tokens, so we'll discuss when we reach for it and when we use something faster.

We'll open the floor for a live Q&A.
